## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
#packages for this project
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(gtsummary)
library(dendextend)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(dtplyr)
library(broom)
library(tidymodels)
library(randomForest)
library(pROC)
library(cluster)
library(uwot)
library(cowplot)
library(modelsummary)
library(vip)
library(dotwhisker)
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#uploading the file

data_file <- "~/Desktop/BMIN5030/Final_Project-Data_11_5_26.xlsx"

#identifying each sheet 
sheet_names <- excel_sheets(data_file)

or_note <- read_excel("~/Desktop/BMIN5030/Final_Project-Data_11_5_26.xlsx", sheet = "OR note")
Dem <- read_excel("~/Desktop/BMIN5030/Final_Project-Data_11_5_26.xlsx", sheet = "Dem")
meds <- read_excel("~/Desktop/BMIN5030/Final_Project-Data_11_5_26.xlsx", sheet = "DC meds")
tonsil_char <- read_excel("~/Desktop/BMIN5030/Final_Project-Data_11_5_26.xlsx", sheet = "tonsil char")
indications <- read_excel("~/Desktop/BMIN5030/Final_Project-Data_11_5_26.xlsx", sheet = "indications")
PTH <- read_excel("~/Desktop/BMIN5030/Final_Project-Data_11_5_26.xlsx", sheet = "PTH")
```

```{r}
#identifying class of mrn variable in each sheet, to ensure consistenty across worksheets so this can be linked to one large worksheet
class(or_note$mrn)
class(Dem$mrn)
class(meds$mrn)
class(tonsil_char$mrn)
class(indications$mrn)
class(PTH$mrn)
class(Comorbidities$mrn)
class(ED_visit$mrn)
class(ED_reason$mrn)
```

```{r}
#changing mrn to character so we can use it for the join
or_note$mrn <- as.character(or_note$mrn)
Dem$mrn <- as.character(Dem$mrn)
tonsil_char$mrn <- as.character(tonsil_char$mrn)
indications$mrn <- as.character(indications$mrn)
ED_reason$mrn <- as.character(ED_reason$mrn)
#joining all the sheets into one large dataset using mrn as the primary key
master <- or_note %>%
  left_join(Dem, by = "mrn") %>%
  left_join(meds, by = "mrn") %>%
  left_join(tonsil_char, by = "mrn") %>%
  left_join(indications, by = "mrn") %>%
  left_join(PTH, by = "mrn") %>%
  left_join(Comorbidities, by = "mrn") %>%
  left_join(ED_visit, by = "mrn") %>%
  left_join(ED_reason, by = "mrn")

names(master)
```

```{r}
#creating new variables
Master_final <- Master_full |>
  mutate(
    Tonsillectomy_Type = case_when(
      grepl("Extracapsular", Tonsillectomy_Type) ~ 1,
      grepl("Intracapsular", Tonsillectomy_Type) ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    Tonsillectomy_Type = factor(
      Tonsillectomy_Type,
      levels = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("Extracapsular", "Intracapsular")
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    tonsil_removal_tool = case_when(
      tonsil_tool %in% c(
        "Suction Bovie",
        "Suction Cautery and Microdebrider",
        "Bipolar Bayonet"
      ) ~ "Other",
      
      tonsil_tool %in% c(
        "Bovie",
        "Coblator",
        "Microdebrider"
      ) ~ tonsil_tool,
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    tonsil_removal_tool = factor(
      tonsil_removal_tool,
      levels = c(
        "Bovie",
        "Coblator",
        "Microdebrider",
        "Other"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    tonsil_cautery_tool = case_when(
      tonsil_cautery_tool %in% c(
        "Suction Bovie",
        "Bovie"
      ) ~ "Suction_Bovie",
      
      tonsil_cautery_tool == "Coblator" ~ "Coblator",
      
      tonsil_cautery_tool == "Coblator & Suction Bovie" ~
        "Coblator & Suction Bovie",
      
      tonsil_cautery_tool %in% c(
        "Blank / missing",
        "Microdebrider",
        "88888888",
        "Bipolar cautery"
      ) ~ "Other",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    tonsil_cautery_tool = factor(
      tonsil_cautery_tool,
      levels = c(
        "Suction_Bovie",
        "Coblator",
        "Coblator & Suction Bovie",
        "Other"
      )
    )
  )|>
  mutate(
    ethnicity = case_when(
      ethnicity %in% c(
        "Choose not to disclose",
        "Choose Not to Disclose",
        "Refused"
      ) ~ "Refused",
      
      ethnicity %in% c(
        "Unknown",
        "Asked But Unknown"
      ) ~ "Missing",
      
      is.na(ethnicity) ~ "Missing",
      
      TRUE ~ ethnicity
    ),
    
    ethnicity = factor(
      ethnicity,
      levels = c(
        "Not Hispanic or Latino",
        "Hispanic or Latino",
        "Other",
        "Refused",
        "Missing"
      )
    )
  )|>
  mutate(
    race = factor(
      race,
      levels = c(
        "White",
        "Black_AA",
        "Multi_Racial",
        "Other",
        "Refused",
        "Unknown"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    language = factor(
      language,
      levels = c(
        "English",
        "Spanish",
        "Other"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ahi = ifelse(ahi == 99999999, NA, ahi),
    co2 = ifelse(co2 == 99999999, NA, co2),
    spo2_nadir = ifelse(spo2_nadir == 99999999, NA, spo2_nadir)
  )|>
  mutate(across(
    c(
      Assitant,
      surgeon_coded,
      sex, 
      asthma,
      autism,
      gerd,
      obesity_hx,
      trisomy_21,
      developmental_delay_hx,
      gastrostomy_tube,
      hurler_syndrome,
      posttransplant_lymphoproliferative_disorder,
      overweight,
      cardiac_repairs_condition_hx,
      any_form_coagulopathy,
      sickle_cell_disease_hx,
      g6pd,
      lung_transplant_prev,
      bone_marrow_transplant_prev,
      Narcotic, 
      Celebrex,
      Dexamethasone,
      Tylenol,
      Hypervascular,
      Infected,
      Cryptic,
      tonsil_stone_finding,
      Other_reason_ED,
      OSA_combined,
      Infection,
      ATH_combined,
      TA_bleed,
      Vomit,
      Vomiting_blood,
      Pain,
      Epistaxis,
      Blood_streaked_sputum,
      Dehydration,
      fever,
      ),
    factor
  ))|>
  mutate(
    NSAID = ifelse(
      Motrin == "1" |
        Toradol == "1",
      1, 0
    ))|>
  mutate(
    return_OR = replace_na(return_OR, "No"),
    TA_ED_visit = replace_na(TA_ED_visit, "No")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    return_OR = factor(
      return_OR,
      levels = c("No", "1"),
      labels = c("No", "Yes")
    ),
    TA_ED_visit = factor(
      TA_ED_visit,
      levels = c("No", "1"),
      labels = c("No", "Yes")
    )
  )|>
  mutate(
    Bleeding = factor(
      replace_na(Bleeding, 0),
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("No", "Yes")
    )
  )
```


```{r}
set.seed(5030)
OR_split <- initial_split(model_OR, prop = 0.75, strata = return_OR)
OR_train <- training(OR_split)
OR_test <- testing(OR_split)

OR_folds <- vfold_cv(OR_train, v = 5, strata = return_OR)

# receipe
OR_recipe <- recipe(
  return_OR ~ .,
  data = model_OR
) |>
  step_unknown(
    all_nominal_predictors(),
    new_level = "Missing"
  ) |>
  step_impute_median(
    all_numeric_predictors()
  ) |>
  step_novel(
    all_nominal_predictors(),
    new_level = "New"
  ) |>
  step_dummy(
    all_nominal_predictors(),
    one_hot = FALSE
  ) |>
  step_zv(
    all_predictors()
  ) |>
  step_normalize(
    all_numeric_predictors()
  )

```

```{r}
#LASSO model
lasso_spec <- logistic_reg(penalty = tune(), mixture = 1) |>
  set_engine("glmnet")

lasso_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(OR_recipe) |>
  add_model(lasso_spec)

lasso_grid <- tibble(penalty = 10^seq(-4, -0.5, length.out = 20))

lasso_tune <- lasso_wf |>
  tune_grid(OR_folds, grid = lasso_grid, metrics = metric_set(roc_auc))

autoplot(lasso_tune)

show_best(lasso_tune, metric = "roc_auc")
select_best(lasso_tune, metric = "roc_auc")

lasso_1se <- select_by_one_std_err(lasso_tune, desc(penalty), metric = "roc_auc")
lasso_1se

lasso_final_wf <- finalize_workflow(lasso_wf, lasso_1se)

lasso_cv <- lasso_final_wf |>
  fit_resamples(OR_folds, control = control_resamples(save_pred = TRUE))

collect_metrics(lasso_cv)

coef(
  extract_fit_parsnip(
    fit(finalize_workflow(lasso_wf, lasso_1se),
        model_OR)
  )$fit,
  s = lasso_1se$penalty
)

```

```{r}

xgb_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(OR_recipe) |>
```

```{r}
show_best(lr_cv, metric = "roc_auc")
show_best(lasso_cv, metric = "roc_auc")
```

```{r}
#comparing models
cv_results <- list(logistic = lr_cv, lasso = lasso_cv,
                   random_forest = rf_cv, boosting = xgb_cv)

cv_metrics <- map(cv_results, collect_metrics) |>
  bind_rows(.id = "model")

cv_metrics |>
  select(model, .metric, mean, std_err) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = .metric, values_from = c(mean, std_err))

cv_preds <- map(cv_results, collect_predictions) |>
  bind_rows(.id = "model")

cv_preds |>
  group_by(model) |>
  roc_curve(return_OR, .pred_Yes, event_level = "second") |>
  autoplot()
```

```{r}

#final eval on test set

final_fit <- last_fit(lasso_final_wf, OR_split)

collect_metrics(final_fit)

collect_predictions(final_fit) |>
  roc_curve(return_OR, .pred_Yes, event_level = "second") |>
  autoplot()
```

```{r}
final_model <- extract_fit_parsnip(final_fit)

tidy(final_model) |>
  arrange(desc(abs(estimate)))

vip(final_model, lambda = lasso_1se$penalty)
```
